notes.system-repo-dependency: This corpus repo depends on the prime-system repo for its DSL parser, compiler, runtime, CLI, and registry. Clone prime-system as a sibling directory: `git clone <prime-system-url> ../prime-system`. The `compile` script above assumes this layout. Override with PRIME_SYSTEM_ROOT env var if your layout differs.
notes.peer-packages: The app/* packages declare workspace:* deps on @prime-lang/types, @prime-lang/compiler, @prime-lang/parser, and @prime-lang/runtime — all of which live in prime-system. A future v0.2 will publish those packages to npm so the sibling-repo requirement can be dropped.
